description: Defines a template class 'flat_tree' implementing a sorted vector-based container similar to std::set or std::map, with methods for insertion, deletion, search, and comparison. Includes internal utility functions and comparator support.

classes.name: base::internal::flat_tree
classes.description: A sorted vector-backed container supporting set/map semantics with customizable key extraction and comparison.

classes.name: base::internal::GetKeyFromValueIdentity
classes.description: A helper struct for containers where key and value are the same.

methods.name: is_multipass
methods.description: Checks if an iterator supports multiple passes (i.e., is at least a forward iterator).

methods.name: LastUnique
methods.description: Removes duplicates, keeping only the last of consecutive equal elements.

methods.name: flat_tree::insert
methods.description: Inserts elements or ranges into the container.

methods.name: flat_tree::erase
methods.description: Removes elements by iterator, range, or key.

methods.name: flat_tree::lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element not less than the key.

methods.name: flat_tree::upper_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element greater than the key.

methods.name: flat_tree::equal_range
methods.description: Returns range of elements equal to the key.
